_meta.purpose: Client registry. Adding client #2 is a row here, not a new workflow.
_meta.rule: Every workflow reads this. Nothing about a client is hardcoded in a node.

defaults._rule: PIN an explicit version. Never '-latest' (Google can swap the model under a QA-passed system) and never '-preview' (can be withdrawn without notice). Confirm availability with: curl -s 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?key=$KEY' | grep '"name"'

n8n._import_order: Import 03 (CORE) then 06 (ledger + escalation), then paste each id into the matching node of 05 (Instagram). A channel pointing at a sub-workflow that does not exist fails in a way that reads like a code bug.

meta_graph._rule: Pinned like the model. Confirm the version the client's app actually exposes during the Business Suite session and update here only — never in a node.

whatsapp._status: STRIPPED 2026-09-15 on ADEDAMOLA's instruction. Shalom Park ships as an INSTAGRAM-ONLY automation. This removes WABA creation, phone-number registration (and with it the risk of wiping a working handset), WhatsApp display-name review, message templates and the 24-hour window. Re-enable by flipping this boolean — the adapter, the normaliser and the tests are all still here and still green.

instagram._primary: THE channel for this client. Comments and DMs, keyword fast lane in front of the brain.

email._status: Parked with WhatsApp — Instagram-only launch. Adapter (04) is built and tested; flip the boolean when wanted.

links._mode_options: none = ship no link (default, safe) | human_line = point buyers at the sales WhatsApp in escalation.primary | concierge = point at Shalom Park's own Cloud API number once it is live
links._attribution: The Ref code lands in the buyer's first WhatsApp message, so the ledger can tie a closed sale back to the exact Instagram keyword that produced it.
links._mode_ruling: mode stays "none" and that is now the CORRECT setting, not a placeholder. On an Instagram-only build the conversation converts inside the DM; bouncing a warm lead to a wa.me link leaks conversions and breaks attribution. Hot leads reach Collins through the ESCALATION (a human being messaged), which needs no WhatsApp API at all.

instagram._limits: Meta allows ONE private reply per comment inside a 7-day window and roughly 200 automated DMs an hour. 180 leaves headroom; overflow queues to a human instead of being dropped.

keywords._surface: IN-HOUSE ONLY. The CSV is the editable source of truth; keywords.md is the generated read-only view. No third-party spreadsheet holds client facts.
keywords._copy_rule: Sell, do not disclaim. No response volunteers what the assistant cannot do — nobody asked. Where a fact is not held, it becomes an offer ("I will get you the breakdown in writing"), never a confession. Every response closes on one question that moves the lead forward. Escalation still fires; the copy just stops announcing it.

alerts._ruling: Email is the interim alert channel. It is HONESTLY WEAKER than a WhatsApp ping — a sales inbox gets checked, a phone buzzes. Stripping the WhatsApp API is what removed the strong option, and that is a real cost of the Instagram-only decision, not a detail. Upgrade path: a Nigerian SMS gateway (Termii / Africa's Talking) at roughly ₦4 a message — at 20 leads a day that is about ₦2,400/month, far inside the docs/07 tooling gate. Set sms_provider and the notifier sends hot leads by SMS and the rest by email.
alerts._from_ruling: Alerts send from alerts@getpropel.tech — a PROPEL-owned mailbox. Never the client's domain (@shalomparknigeria.com) and not a personal address: both erase Propel from the from-line, which is the point. Every alert is a receipt — 20 a day landing in their sales inbox saying 'your assistant found you a buyer' is the drumbeat the commission conversation rests on. Their mailbox is also revocable infrastructure, and sending AS their domain fails SPF/DKIM without their credentials. Set this up BEFORE go-live: changing a sender once alerts are flowing means the first ones from the new address can land in spam, and a missed lead alert is the failure this layer exists to prevent. SMTP host and port come from the Hostinger panel when the mailbox is created.

_ledger.note: Every answered message writes a lead row and an append-only event. Commission on one unit is ₦5.5–6m; evidence that lives only in the client's infrastructure is not evidence.
